entries.title: HTTP Caching (RFC 9111)
entries.version: RFC 9111, Standards Track, June 2022 (R. Fielding/M. Nottingham/J. Reschke, Eds.)
entries.locator: body lines: 581 §4.2 Freshness; 784 §4.2.4 Serving Stale Responses; 801 §4.3 Validation; 1081 §5.2 Cache-Control (5.2.1.2 max-stale request dir; 5.2.2.1 max-age response dir); 520 max-age=0 revalidation
entries.limits: General HTTP cache semantics; no tile/map specifics; stale-while-revalidate and stale-if-error are ABSENT from this text (verified by grep) — they remain RFC 5861 extensions; no storage-size/eviction quota guidance.

entries.title: HTTP Cache-Control Extensions for Stale Content (RFC 5861)
entries.version: RFC 5861, Informational, April 2011 (M. Nottingham, Yahoo! Inc.)
entries.locator: TOC lines 67-70; §3 stale-while-revalidate (+3.1 example), §4 stale-if-error (+4.1 example)
entries.limits: Informational; defines the two extension directives only; window sizes are server-chosen values with no recommended bounds; no acquisition/resume semantics.

entries.title: HTTP Semantics (RFC 9110)
entries.locator: body lines: 3570 §8.8.3 ETag; 4799 §10.2.3 Retry-After; 5872 §13.1.2 If-None-Match; 5942 §13.1.3 If-Modified-Since; 6467 §14.2 Range; 7755 §15.5.17 416 Range Not Satisfiable
entries.limits: Semantics only: validators, conditional GET, byte ranges/partial content, Retry-After (single date/delay value); defines no backoff algorithm, no cache policy (see 9111), no retention bounds.

entries.title: OSMF Tile Usage Policy
entries.version: Live OMF operations page 'Tile Usage Policy', undated HTML, retrieved as stored
entries.locator: sections: Quick summary; 2 Attribution; 3.1 Identification; 3.2 Caching; 3.3 Protocols; 4 Prohibited: bulk downloading ('scraping') and offline use; 5 Caching proxies; one explicit 'If-Modified-Since' mention (grep count 1)
entries.limits: Service usage policy for the osm.org tile endpoint, not a client design spec; requires valid HTTP caching per its Caching section; sets download-bulk limits, not client-side display-staleness or store-retention rules; page carries no revision/date metadata.

entries.title: OpenStreetMap Wiki: Servers/Tile Rendering (incl. 'Tile disk usage')
entries.version: MediaWiki page, wgCurRevisionId 3082592 at capture; 'Tile disk usage' resolves (redirect) into Servers/Tile Rendering
entries.locator: 'Tile disk usage' section link in page body; mod_tile expiry parameters 'expiry: false' and 'expiry: 86400' (86400 s = 1 day) as rendered config examples
entries.limits: Community wiki, not normative; disk/expiry discussion is illustrative config, not a policy; no client acquisition or display-staleness guidance.

entries.title: AWS SDKs and Tools Reference Guide: Retry behavior
entries.version: Live 'latest' SDK reference page, retrieved as stored
entries.locator: grep counts at capture: 'retry mode' x6, 'retry quota' x17, 'token bucket' x5 — Standard mode (exponential backoff with jitter) and Adaptive mode; retry-quota token bucket (e.g., 500-token capacity style) guards against repeated failures
entries.limits: Vendor SDK behavior doc; concrete backoff/quota engineering precedent, not an HTTP standard; no map/tile specifics; page version not dated in HTML.
